IRQ_and_exclusion_effect_boundary.guards: Take refuses recursive ownership; modeled P/S cannot nest, modeled R permits only outerP; release requires same LIFO address, same saved flag option/value and same HOST owner. irqsave restores its saved modeled IF; noirq does not change it. Alloc/free/hostreply/forward/raw lookup refuse tracked P/R/S or hash-borrow context.
IRQ_and_exclusion_effect_boundary.modeled_only: HOST Mutex+Condvar and per-HOST-thread LOCAL implement blocking mutual exclusion, held-address stack, tracked IRQ-enable bit and saved0/0x200 IF values. No CLI/STI/GS/MSR/PMC/native hardware instruction is executed by adapter source.
IRQ_and_exclusion_effect_boundary.scope_limits: This is an effect model, not execution of genuine spinlock/preemption providers or proof of native RFLAGS/hardware behavior. CPU id is controlled0. An unregistered lock defaults to modeled Registry; final fixture must explicitly classify P/S addresses wherever it claims those order checks. No claim all real project locks were independently classified by this adapter.

allocation_effect_boundary.borrow_contract: Origin strings and typed pointers must be valid for each unsafe call; actual production static origins are retained. This review does not authorize arbitrary malformed-pointer tests.
allocation_effect_boundary.failure: One explicit fail_next_allocation or genuine HOST allocator null logs AllocFailed and returns null. There is no forced project allocation/refcount success.
allocation_effect_boundary.real_HOST_storage: std::alloc alloc/dealloc with recorded Layout; max alignment of actual Thread/Process/CpuLocalVar/X86UserContext/Mckfd/usize is at least64 through CpuLocalVar. Nonzero0xa5 contents deliberately do not repair missing production initialization.
allocation_effect_boundary.reset: reset_trace clears observation/reply scripts/failure flag only. It does not free a live allocation, reset ID, clear a production registry or change a project owner. Fixture must call trace reset only at its declared quiescent scenario boundaries; reset itself is not cleanup evidence.
allocation_effect_boundary.tracking: Every successful allocation gets monotonically checked u64 ID starting1, actual address/size/flags and copied original file bytes/line. Live map retains its true Layout. Free removes exactly the existing map record, retains original allocation ID/origin alongside free origin and deallocates exact address/Layout; foreign/double free fails. Null free is separately logged, not treated as a prior allocation.

hash_pointer_and_project_ownership_bound.borrow_effects: Success records exact process/node plus modeled saved IRQ and disables modeled IRQ. Miss returnsnull without an owned borrow or flag change. Unlock requires original same process/node and no P/R/S lock, then restores the saved modeled IF. This tests net controlled lookup/borrow effects, not genuine process-hash/MCS provider code or native IRQ node memory.
hash_pointer_and_project_ownership_bound.no_positive_provider_claim: Allocation IDs, lock traces, scripted replies and raw lookup are explicitly lower effects; they cannot alone close a project provider/owner/runtime/native contract.
hash_pointer_and_project_ownership_bound.raw_lookup_only: register_process stores an explicitly supplied raw Process pointer. find_process returns that exact pointer unchanged, including a real refcount0 Process; it never reads/writes/refills/increments/decrements refcount, allocates a Process, pins an event or fabricates a valid group/target.
hash_pointer_and_project_ownership_bound.real_code_stays_required: Real target_process/events/groups/monitors/descriptors/thread counters/forward ownership, ref/group/list/lifetime/deferred retirement, actual waitq/schedule and the real pure argument getter must stay in the coherent fixture source. This adapter implements none of those project owner decisions. Final fixture must retain the actual typed Process/Thread storage while raw pointers/borrows can be used.

host_reply_and_forward_close_boundary.forward_close: Requires literal __NR_close3 and nonnull context; reads arg0 through the genuine actual pure source getter supplied by common fixture, records exact number/arg0/context/current thread/process/result. It does not perform close, invoke backend/native, initialize a dummy request or bypass ownership bodies.
host_reply_and_forward_close_boundary.host_reply: Requires actual current Thread and nonnull Thread.proc, no tracked kernel/hash exclusion; records full actual72B request, supplied CIntcpu and real typed thread/process addresses before returning the scripted signed result.
host_reply_and_forward_close_boundary.not_scenarios: Scripts/effects are controlled lower inputs; trace markers contain no golden/scenario or ownership acceptance decision.

Exact signed negative/zero/positive result is returned unchanged, not cast to unsigned or converted to a success code.
